messages:
partners-team: FYI kickoff w/ CobaltML this AM. They want a "download-only" quantized SKU on cloud marketplaces plus an option for SI co-managed installs. Need quick alignment: legal, runtime, SI, billing, and marketing.
lucas: When you say download-only, do we allow end-customers to redistribute? Cobalt's preferred flow is marketplace -> buyer downloads -> self-host. That triggers redistribution and export checks.
anya: Cobalt proposes a two-track license: academic/research permissive (CC-BY-like) and a commercial distribution addendum that forbids rehosting to public endpoints and requires traceability. Legal will want explicit non-derivative-public-hosting language.
ralph: Runtime note: 3-bit/4-bit quant builds have specific kernel patches. If we publish downloads, we should also publish an official "redwood-validated-quant" container + a small runtime wrapper that verifies checker-sums and enforces telemetry opt-in. Otherwise we'll see mismatched kernels.
legal: Export control + provenance note: require a short training-data provenance attestation and a jurisdictional sales control list. Also recommend a clause that requires distributors to implement geofencing and to deny sales to embargoed entities.
ops-bot: Suggested checklist created: /playbooks/marketplace-cobalt/onboard-checklist.md (SSO, KMS, telemetry schema, geoblock test, revshare mapping). Link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/marketplace-cobalt/onboard-checklist.md
lucas: Billing question  marketplace downloads vs hosted inference. For hosted we can do per-inference rev share. For downloads they asked for a cut of marketplace list-price. We should map marketplace SKU ids to partner_id and expose partner_sku in billing exports.
anya: Marketing: no public co-announcement until (1) marketplace SKU live, (2) SI runbook validated, (3) signed commercial addendum & provenance attestation. Propose 10 business day embargo after live listing. Request Cobalt logo + short partner quote.
ralph: SI team: can support a co-managed offering but we need SSO + KMS patterns and explicit telemetry fields that are allowed. Cobalt wants aggregated perf metrics only; enterprise customers can opt-out. Please define exact telemetry keys.
legal: Draft clause (working): "Distributor may not publish, expose, or operate the Model or its derivatives on publicly accessible hosted API endpoints. Distributor shall implement geoblocking consistent with applicable export controls and maintain provenance records for Model distribution. Breach requires immediate notification to CobaltML and Redwood"
partners-team: Action items I captured:
- legal: finalize commercial addendum + export/geoblock clauses (due Tue EOD)
- runtime (ralph, lucas): build redwood-validated-quant container + checksum wrapper (POC by next Wed)
- SI: produce SSO/KMS/runbook + allowed telemetry keys (due Thu)
- marketing: draft announcement timeline + request logo/quote from Cobalt (due Fri)
Please ack or add.
lucas: Acknowledged. I'll add a short test matrix for kernel/version combos to the checklist.
anya: Also request an indemnity carveout for misuse if Cobalt's license allows downstream modification. Add no-derivative-public-hosting and a requirement that marketplace sales flow through approved channels.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace mapping created: partner:cobaltml -> sku_prefix: COBALT-QNT. Billing label plan: partner_sku, listing_id attached to transactions.
partners-team: Thanks all 914 I'll schedule a sync with Cobalt + legal + eng + SI for Thu 11am PT.
